senses.sense_definition: The medical specialty focused on the use of imaging technologies to diagnose and treat diseases.

examples.text: The hospital is investing in new equipment for the department of <w>radiology</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这家医院正在为<w>放射科</w>投资购买新设备。

examples.text: After the accident, the patient was sent to <w>radiology</w> for a series of scans.

target_lang_translations.zh: 事故发生后，病人被送往<w>放射科</w>进行了一系列扫描。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 医学中利用影像技术诊断和治疗疾病的专业领域。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指医院中负责影像诊断的科室。
指医学中关于影像诊断的学科。

senses.sense_definition: The historical or specialized use of radioactive substances for medical diagnosis and therapy.

examples.text: Early <w>radiology</w> often involved the direct application of radioactive isotopes to treat tumors.

target_lang_translations.zh: 早期的<w>放射疗法</w>通常涉及直接使用放射性同位素来治疗肿瘤。

examples.text: Modern nuclear medicine has largely replaced the older methods of <w>radiology</w> that relied on radioactive substances.

target_lang_translations.zh: 现代核医学在很大程度上取代了那些依赖放射性物质的旧式<w>放射疗法</w>。

traits.comment: Refers to an older scope of the field now largely covered by nuclear medicine.

target_lang_definitions.zh: 历史上或特定领域中利用放射性物质进行医疗诊断和治疗的方法。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指利用放射性物质进行治疗的手段。
